data.name: Conflito_Botao_Corrigir_Explicar
data.value: Builds the DLSS 5 chain again and leaves only the piece this game needs. Nothing else in the folder is touched.

data.name: Conflito_Botao_Explicar
data.value: Renames them with a suffix — nothing is deleted, and removing the suffix puts them back.

data.name: Conflito_Grau_Bloqueio
data.comment: Pastilha de gravidade de um conflito: impede o DLSS 5 de funcionar.

data.name: Conflito_Grau_Info
data.comment: Pastilha de gravidade: convive, so para saber que existe.

data.name: Conflito_Nenhum
data.value: Nothing else here competes with DLSS 5.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_DlssgFsr3
data.value: Replaces frame generation, not upscaling — it does not compete with the neural pass. Listed so you know it is here.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_DlssTweaks
data.value: Overrides DLSS presets and resolution scale underneath us, so what you set in the launcher may not be what runs.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_DxvkDgVoodoo
data.value: DXVK and dgVoodoo2 both claim d3d9.dll. Only one can load; the other is a file that never runs. Reinstall and pick one translator.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_FakeNvapi
data.value: Spoofs the NVIDIA API. The addon asks the driver which GPU this is to pick the model build, and gets an answer that is not the real card.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_Generico
data.value: Another tool is installed here. It does not appear to compete with DLSS 5.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_OptiScaler
data.value: Hooks the same NGX entry points the neural pass uses. Two things redirecting DLSS at once is not a configuration — the launcher installs its own OptiScaler when it is the right path.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_PonteFeeder
data.value: The Bridge is left over here: on the Feeder route the D3D12 device comes from the Feeder itself, so the Bridge has nothing to do. It does no harm, and reinstalling DLSS 5 clears it.
data.comment: pt: era "mutuamente exclusivos" com grau de bloqueio. Medido no Saints Row The Third: o jogo roda com os dois na pasta e roda sem a ponte. Sobra, nao bloqueio.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_Proxy
data.value: {1} occupies {0} — the slot our ReShade needs to load. While it sits there, the DLSS 5 chain never starts in this executable.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_ReShadeDuplo
data.value: ReShade would load twice in the same process — once through the Vulkan layer, once through this proxy. That is the known cause of a 0xc0000005 crash at startup.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_Restos
data.value: {0} renamed leftovers from earlier attempts. Harmless on their own, but they make the folder hard to read — including for the launcher.

data.name: Conflito_Porque_SpecialK
data.value: Injects into the same process and can take the proxy slot. Usually coexists, but it is the first thing to remove if the game stops opening.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Community
data.value: Community build — NVIDIA did not sign this file. It exists to run on RTX 40, where NVIDIA's own kernels do not. The author of the patch says not to use it in online or anti-cheat games: it modifies a file the anti-cheat may check.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Done

data.name: Settings_Runtime_DoneCommunity
data.value: Runtime stored. It is a community build: the signature no longer checks out, and the GPU requirement is lifted. Read the warning on the card.

data.name: Settings_Runtime_Have

data.name: Settings_Runtime_None
data.value: Not here yet. The launcher looks for a copy on this machine, then falls back to the RHI index.
